failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.RabbitMQ.Client.Tests, RabbitMQ.Client, RabbitMQ.Client, tests/... / RabbitMQ.Client (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: All three failure annotations are 'Process completed with exit code -1073741502' (0xC0000142 / STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED), a known Windows runner process-initialization failure occurring in post-test steps (Check for hang dump files, Upload logs and test results, Copy/Upload CLI E2E recordings, Generate test results summary, Post Checkout code). This matches the well-documented 'windows-process-init-failure-0xc0000142' prior cause (19 occurrences) and is unrelated to PR changes, which only touch NuGet config, build scripts, and docs.
failed_steps: Copy CLI E2E recordings for upload

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Docker.Tests, Hosting.Docker, Hosting.Docker, tests/Asp... / Hosting.Docker (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: The DockerComposeTests.DeployWithDashboard_PrintsDashboardAndServiceEndpoints test failed because 'docker compose up' exited with code 1, causing the assertion on endpoint output to see an empty collection. This matches the known 'docker-compose-port-already-in-use' prior cause (docker compose up failures leading to Assert.Contains failures on empty collections in this exact test). The PR under test only modifies NuGet config, build scripts, and docs/tests unrelated to Docker Compose publishing.
